surface_mechanism_description: Hydrogen abstraction from Si-H* sites by amine ligands of the Hf precursor, facilitated by the presence of OH groups on the Si surface, leading to the formation of a four-membered Si-O-Hf-Si bonding structure that can rapidly oxidize.
evidence: The calculations suggest that hydrogen removal proceeds by H abstraction by an amine ligand of the Hf precursor and that the abstraction reaction is made more facile by the presence of OH on the otherwise H-terminated Si surface.
